name: net_format_ipv4_address
description: Net::FormatIpv4Address formats a packed IPv4 integer into dotted-quad text.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x43cf40 validates the fastcall outText/ipAddress contract, four low-byte extractions from the packed IP address, right shift by 8 after each octet, and CRT sprintf with format "%d.%d.%d.%d".
Native smoke net_format_ipv4_address_smoke verifies zero, all-ones, and mixed packed values, including the low-to-high byte order shown in Binary Ninja.
